initial_simplification: Mice have been important in neuroscience research because they are easy to control and study, helping scientists understand how the brain works. In the past, researchers often chose male mice for experiments instead of female mice. This was partly because they were worried that the hormonal changes in female mice could lead to behavior that might affect the results.

source_text: Mice have long been a central part of neuroscience research, providing a flexible model that scientists can control and study to learn more about the intricate inner workings of the brain. Historically, researchers have favored male mice over female mice in experiments, in part due to concern that the hormone cycle in females causes behavioral variation that could throw off results.
target_text: Mice are an important part of brain research because scientists can easily control and study them to understand how the brain works. Researchers have mostly used male mice in experiments because they worry that the hormonal changes in female mice could lead to different behaviors, which might affect the results.
